shots.crop_boundary: 人物完整轮廓四周至少留 8% 安全边距，尤其不在膝、踝、肘、腕处截断；地面结构必须延伸到画框之外
shots.set_design: 只使用真实可拍的台阶、道路标线、地砖或光影边界，让两组以上斜线在人物附近相交；清除无意义墙面与空旷棚景
shots.must_show: 俯角至少 35°，地面占画面一半以上，完整身体与投影可辨，人物落在几何交点而非正中央
shots.reject_if: 接近平视、地面几何不主导、人物像贴在空房间、正面站军姿、几何线与人物没有关系
shots.lighting_setup: 环境光优先，必要时使用白色反光板
shots.palette: 自然肤色、环境原色和轻微对比
shots.composition_intent: pronounced high-angle overhead fashion photograph, full body, graphic ground geometry, diagonal composition, subject off-center
shots.action_anchor: subject walks diagonally or sits at a geometric intersection
master_must_show: ground occupies at least half frame
two or more lines intersect near subject
master_crop_boundary: full feet or seated limbs visible
shots.generator_prompt: pronounced high-angle full-body fashion photograph, graphic ground geometry, diagonal composition, subject off-center, visible contact shadow. a believable real-world location. Preserve the subject and clothing specified in the scene brief. Photorealistic fashion editorial, natural anatomy, believable available light.
shots.negative_prompt: bikini, swimwear, lingerie, underwear, nudity, topless, revealing clothing, eye-level, low-angle, centered symmetrical portrait, waist-up, cropped legs, empty gray floor, deformed hands, extra fingers, duplicate person, warped limbs, bad face, plastic skin, watermark, text, logo
shots.execution_note: 先锁定真实场景、画框边界和机位，再让模特执行动作；不得用退回平视居中半身像的方式补数。

acceptance_gate.crop: pass only if crop_boundary is visibly satisfied
acceptance_gate.set: pass only if foreground, subject action, and background form one spatial event
acceptance_gate.camera: pass only if the requested camera language is recognizable without reading the label
